data.title: Deepfake Vehicle Damage Photo Pattern — Pixel Artifacts, Lighting Inconsistencies, and AI Generation Indicators
data.description: Detects deepfake vehicle damage photos in insurance claims by analyzing pixel-level artifacts, lighting and shadow inconsistencies, and metadata indicating AI image generation tools. AI-generated vehicle damage photos represent an acute threat to auto insurance claims processing, as generative AI can produce realistic collision, hail, and vandalism damage images that bypass visual inspection by claims adjusters. Detection relies on computer vision analysis: GAN-generated images exhibit characteristic pixel artifacts at damage boundaries, physically impossible lighting/shadow combinations, and frequency domain signatures distinct from camera-captured photos. This rule targets vehicle-specific claims (collision, comprehensive, vandalism) and correlates image forensics scores with claim characteristics.

detection.condition: selection AND (filter_pixel_artifacts OR filter_lighting OR filter_shadow OR filter_ai_probability OR filter_metadata_anomaly)

enrichment_required.source: Computer vision model analyzing pixel patterns at damage boundaries for GAN artifacts
Ensemble model combining frequency domain, pixel, and metadata analysis

queries.cql:
// CQL for Deepfake Vehicle Damage Photo Pattern Detection — DL-0195
// Detects AI-generated vehicle damage photos via pixel and metadata analysis
ClaimPhotos
| claim_type = "vehicle_collision" OR claim_type = "vehicle_comprehensive" OR claim_type = "vehicle_vandalism"
| document_type = "photo"
| submission_date >= now() - 30d
| pixel_artifact_score > 0.8 OR lighting_consistency_score < 0.3 OR shadow_consistency_score < 0.3 OR ai_generation_probability > 0.75 OR (exif_camera_model = null AND exif_software != null)
| primary_indicator := if(pixel_artifact_score > 0.8, "high_pixel_artifacts", if(lighting_consistency_score < 0.3, "inconsistent_lighting", if(shadow_consistency_score < 0.3, "inconsistent_shadows", if(ai_generation_probability > 0.75, "high_ai_probability", if(exif_camera_model = null AND exif_software != null, "metadata_anomaly", "multiple_indicators")))))
| combined_score := round((coalesce(pixel_artifact_score, 0) * 0.3) + ((1 - coalesce(lighting_consistency_score, 1)) * 0.2) + ((1 - coalesce(shadow_consistency_score, 1)) * 0.2) + (coalesce(ai_generation_probability, 0) * 0.3), 3)
| groupBy([claim_id, claimant_id, claim_type, vehicle_vin],
    function=[count() as flagged_photos,
              collect(primary_indicator) as indicators,
              max(combined_score) as max_deepfake_score,
              sum(claim_amount) as total_claim_value])
| sort(max_deepfake_score, order=desc)
queries.sql:
-- SQL: Deepfake Vehicle Damage Photo Pattern Detection
-- Claims photos with pixel artifacts, lighting/shadow inconsistencies, AI indicators
SELECT
  c.claim_id,
  c.claimant_id,
  c.claim_type,
  c.claim_amount,
  c.vehicle_vin,
  p.photo_id,
  p.file_name,
  p.pixel_artifact_score,
  p.lighting_consistency_score,
  p.shadow_consistency_score,
  p.ai_generation_probability,
  p.exif_camera_model,
  p.exif_software,
  p.exif_creation_date,
  CASE
    WHEN p.pixel_artifact_score > 0.8 THEN 'high_pixel_artifacts'
    WHEN p.lighting_consistency_score < 0.3 THEN 'inconsistent_lighting'
    WHEN p.shadow_consistency_score < 0.3 THEN 'inconsistent_shadows'
    WHEN p.ai_generation_probability > 0.75 THEN 'high_ai_probability'
    WHEN p.exif_camera_model IS NULL AND p.exif_software IS NOT NULL
      THEN 'metadata_anomaly'
    ELSE 'multiple_indicators'
  END AS primary_indicator,
  (COALESCE(p.pixel_artifact_score, 0) * 0.3
   + (1 - COALESCE(p.lighting_consistency_score, 1)) * 0.2
   + (1 - COALESCE(p.shadow_consistency_score, 1)) * 0.2
   + COALESCE(p.ai_generation_probability, 0) * 0.3
  ) AS combined_deepfake_score,
  COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY c.claimant_id) AS claimant_total_flagged_photos
FROM claims c
JOIN claim_photos p ON c.claim_id = p.claim_id
WHERE c.claim_type IN ('vehicle_collision', 'vehicle_comprehensive', 'vehicle_vandalism')
  AND p.submission_date >= DATEADD(DAY, -30, CURRENT_DATE)
  AND (
    p.pixel_artifact_score > 0.8
    OR p.lighting_consistency_score < 0.3
    OR p.shadow_consistency_score < 0.3
    OR p.ai_generation_probability > 0.75
    OR (p.exif_camera_model IS NULL AND p.exif_software IS NOT NULL)
  )
ORDER BY combined_deepfake_score DESC, c.claim_amount DESC
queries.splunk:
`comment("Splunk SPL: Deepfake Vehicle Damage Photo Pattern Detection")`
`comment("Detects AI-generated vehicle damage photos via pixel and metadata analysis")`
index=flame_insurance sourcetype=flame:claims_processing
  (claim_type="vehicle_collision" OR claim_type="vehicle_comprehensive"
   OR claim_type="vehicle_vandalism")
  document_type="photo"
| eval is_flagged = case(
    pixel_artifact_score > 0.8, 1,
    lighting_consistency_score < 0.3, 1,
    shadow_consistency_score < 0.3, 1,
    ai_generation_probability > 0.75, 1,
    isnull(exif_camera_model) AND isnotnull(exif_software), 1,
    1=1, 0)
| where is_flagged=1
| eval primary_indicator = case(
    pixel_artifact_score > 0.8, "high_pixel_artifacts",
    lighting_consistency_score < 0.3, "inconsistent_lighting",
    shadow_consistency_score < 0.3, "inconsistent_shadows",
    ai_generation_probability > 0.75, "high_ai_probability",
    isnull(exif_camera_model) AND isnotnull(exif_software), "metadata_anomaly",
    1=1, "multiple_indicators")
| eval combined_score = round(
    (coalesce(pixel_artifact_score, 0) * 0.3)
    + ((1 - coalesce(lighting_consistency_score, 1)) * 0.2)
    + ((1 - coalesce(shadow_consistency_score, 1)) * 0.2)
    + (coalesce(ai_generation_probability, 0) * 0.3), 3)
| stats count AS flagged_photos,
        values(primary_indicator) AS indicators,
        max(combined_score) AS max_deepfake_score,
        sum(claim_amount) AS total_claim_value
  BY claim_id, claimant_id, claim_type, vehicle_vin
| sort - max_deepfake_score

Photos of actual damage that has been legitimately enhanced for visibility
Low-quality camera phones producing artifacts similar to GAN generation
